title: Sharp librsvg memory vulnerability
preconditions: glibc Linux for documented RCE conditions
runtime hardening including Node PIE status
notes: Global librsvg overrides need independent version evidence. Blocking VipsForeignLoadSvg mitigates SVG decoding; PIE mitigates RCE but does not establish library patch state. Unknown libc/PIE stays unknown.
scope_policy: One distinct exploit per repository; aliases and affected products share this scope.
research_notice: Original research foundation retained in research_origin and Git history. Offline evidence implementation; no real asset assessment is claimed.

research_origin.notice: Source research for a planned checker; not an executable rule or assessment result.

implementation_scope: Offline operator-supplied evidence only. No application execution, image decoding, network scanning, exploit verification or compromise detection.
native_library_policy: Global librsvg requires independent upstream provenance and exact version evidence. 2.63.2+ within 2.63 is reported remediation; earlier global versions are unknown because no independent affected-range lower bound is published.
